newsitem.title: JAPAN: Kobe rubber futures mixed in after-hours trade.
newsitem.headline: Kobe rubber futures mixed in after-hours trade.

text.p: Kobe rubber futures were mixed in after-hours trade on Thursday, on technical corrections after hefty gains during the day, traders said.
Prices ranged from 0.3 yen per kg lower to 0.5 yen firmer than the day's close. The benchmark July contract was down 0.2 yen at 156.2 yen.

During the day, the yen's continued fall against the dollar stimulated animated short-covering. "Private investors, who stayed out of the market despite the recent yen's weakness, were finally coming back," one trader said.
